[SWS_CM_10261] Serialization of an associative map
⌈
As far as serialization is
concerned the serialized representation of an associative map shall consist of the fol-
lowing parts without any intermediate padding:
• Length field: A length field describing the size of the associative map excluding
the length field itself in units of bytes.
• Elements: The individual map elements themselves
⌋
